thread:
deploy-bot: Preflight snapshot for Change Window starting 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC. Observability snapshot: https://console.redwood/infradash/snap/abc123. Baselines: p50=15ms, p95=120ms, error_rate=0.12%. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% over 10m. Running preflight checks now. :rocket:

liz: Looking at the p95 for embed-service on eu-west canary — it's trending 140ms right now (baseline 120). Not huge but noticeable.

sam: I see a small bump in 429s from embed-route around +7m, about 0.3% -> 0.9% in the canary window.

priya: Can someone run a quick tail on the embed pod logs? I'd like the request path pattern.

sam: Running:`kubectl -n prod logs -l app=embed --since=10m | grep " 429 " | head -n 50`

aj: If error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m we should pause rollout and pin. Deploy policy: pause -> notify oncall -> rollback or patch.

deploy-bot: Alert rule deployed for this rollout: `canary:error_rate > 0.5% for 5m` -> action: pause-rollout + notify #eng-oncall. I'll post updates in thread.

jen: Release notes checklist: confirm no DB schema migration and list of client-facing changes is in https://confluence.redwood/releases/2026-03-21-embed. Anyone confirm migrations?

liz: No migrations in this release. Only model swap and config flag to enable KV prefetch.

priya: Model note: v2-quant has slightly higher p95 but lower token-cost. If p95 keeps drifting we should pin to v2-base as quick rollback.

sam: Quick triage logs show a spike in upstream latency from the reranker: `upstream_latency_ms` peaking ~300ms during a short window. Not all requests fail, but it inflates p95.

aj: Ops proposal: hold canary at 5% while we investigate. If we decide to roll back, we target a version pin to `embed:2026-03-20-rc4`.

liz: Agree. Hold at 5% and set manual gates: no +traffic until p95 < 130ms and error_rate < 0.3% for 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary hold enacted by request from liz. Traffic remains at 5%. Notifying @eng-oncall. Snapshot link for triage: https://console.redwood/infradash/snap/abc123?paused=true

priya: I'll try warming KV cache on canary pods to see if p95 improves (KV cache warm-up was a concern in previous runs).

sam: Also saw one GPU host with elevated CPU on python worker (g-12). `top` shows python ~85% for a brief period — likely a hot shard. Scaling not triggered.

jen: I'll update the release notes to reflect the hold and add rollback instructions for the support team. Link updated: https://confluence.redwood/releases/2026-03-21-embed#hold

liz: Decision: Hold canary, triage for 15m, pin plan ready if we cross threshold. Assigning action items: priya -> KV warm, sam -> gather logs/traces, aj -> prepare pin and rollback command.

priya: Started KV warm script: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --env=prod --selector=app=embed`

sam: Collected traces and pushed to the snapshot (trace id t-9988).

aj: Pin ready: `deployctl pin --service embed --version embed:2026-03-20-rc4 --reason "canary hold"` — will execute if alert triggers or we decide to roll back.

deploy-bot: Triage update at +10m: p95 now 128ms, error_rate 0.28% (10m window). KV warm-up showing improvement.

liz: Good progress. Keep hold for one more 10m window, if metrics stay below our gate we'll resume ramp to 25% with smaller step (5% -> 15% -> 25%).

jen: Support FYI: I've posted an internal note and added rollback steps to the incident runbook.

deploy-bot: Final note: will post another snapshot at +20m or on decision. If anyone needs me to execute the pin/rollback, reply with `@deploy-bot execute pin` or `@deploy-bot rollback`.

sam: Thanks — monitoring closely.

priya: On it.

liz: Closing loop for now — hold remains. Reopen thread for roll decision. :white_check_mark:
